column1: # The native compiler that recovery starts from, one per platform: platform,
# release tag, asset, SHA-256. It is native stage two, byte-identical to the
# stage three it compiles. The native-seed workflow publishes it;
# No pins: the generated code changed (arrays, unions and strings are freed, copies became moves), so the pinned
# compiler of 5621c10e8 builds a stage two that differs from the stage three it compiles. Stage one comes from the
# bytecode seed until the native-seed workflow publishes a compiler built from this code and its pins are committed.
